summary: The scheduler MVP targets service-based businesses in Ashtabula County needing appointment booking solutions. Research identified 5 high-potential leads across HVAC, salon, auto repair, and medical sectors. Most current businesses rely on phone-based scheduling, presenting an opportunity for modern online booking systems.

leads.name: Blank Heating Company Inc
leads.fit_rationale: Family-owned HVAC business for 3 generations with OH LIC #25138. Currently uses 'Request an Appointment' web form but lacks real-time online booking. High-value service calls make scheduling efficiency critical. Strong local reputation with free in-home estimates.
leads.source: Brave web search + direct website crawl

leads.name: Ultimate Appearance Salon
leads.fit_rationale: Established salon specializing in color, cuts, and special occasion hair. Currently appointment-only via phone call. No online booking system detected. Active social media presence (Instagram, Facebook) indicates tech-savvy ownership that would adopt scheduling software.
leads.source: Brave web search + direct website crawl

leads.name: Route 20 Auto Repair
leads.fit_rationale: Ashtabula auto repair shop emphasizing transparent customer communication ('no surprises'). Focus on informing customers during repairs. Appointment-based service model with diagnostic and repair scheduling needs. Could benefit from customer self-service booking.

leads.name: Rural Health Clinic of Ashtabula (LECOM Health)
leads.fit_rationale: Certified Exemplary Provider clinic with specific appointment scheduling needs. Currently phone-only booking. Limited hours (4 days/week) make efficient scheduling critical. Part of LECOM Health network with potential for broader rollout across affiliated clinics.

leads.name: HAVE Heating and Cooling
leads.fit_rationale: HVAC contractor serving Ashtabula with 24/7 emergency service. Appointment-based business with seasonal demand spikes. Prominent 'schedule your appointment' call-to-action on website but uses phone-only booking. Emergency service offering creates need for after-hours scheduling capability.

branding_quality_assessment.target_brand_reasoning: The scheduler MVP is designed as a white-label SaaS tool for appointment-based businesses. No specific target brand is identified - the tool is intended to be resold/rebranded for local service businesses including HVAC, salons, medical clinics, auto repair, and similar appointment-driven sectors in Ashtabula County.

aesthetics_and_layout_notes.color_scheme: Professional blue-dominant palette with orange accents - standard SaaS trust pattern suitable for service businesses
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.typography: Clean sans-serif, highly readable - appropriate for professional services
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.layout: Centered card-based layout with clear hierarchy - effective for single-purpose booking tool
aesthetics_and_layout_notes.component_quality: Well-styled buttons and inputs with subtle shadows - modern appearance
recommendations: Add industry-specific color themes (salon=pink/rose, medical=blue/teal, HVAC=red/orange)
Include before/after calendar view in confirmation area
Add business logo upload placeholder for white-label deployment

whitelabel_potential.assessment: The scheduler architecture is highly modular and generic, making it an excellent white-label candidate. The core booking flow (select service → pick time → confirm → receive notification) applies across HVAC, salons, medical, auto repair, dental, chiropractic, and other appointment-based businesses.
